Never include Tennessee or Kentucky. If p4 refuses, Ventnor still blocks them from assembling yellow without me; do not sell it to p2. Next action is that p4 offer before ending the turn, then build orange if the set lands. p3 will have ~$740 and can house pink hard — orange houses are the answer, not more cash to p3."}
